target.title: feat(webchat): composer lobster mascot perches on the empty prompt
target.body:
Closes #102754

## What Problem This Solves

The Control UI chat composer is a dead surface while empty: a bare input and placeholder text. OpenClaw has a strong lobster identity (sidebar logo, dreams-scene sleeper, `icons.lobster`), but nothing alive on the surface people actually stare at between messages.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a decorative `openclaw-composer-lobster` element that perches on the top edge of the prompt while the composer is quietly idle, and ducks behind the box the moment anything happens. It is drawn in the smooth OpenClaw lobster style (same species as `icons.lobster`/the dreams sleeper — deliberately not pixel art), and it is seeded per session + page load so every new session hatches a slightly different lobster:

- **Look:** shell palette (crimson, coral, teal, violet, ink, rare gold), size, perky/droopy antennae, accessory (none, crown, sprout, eyepatch), perch spot, facing.
- **Personality:** sleepy / zoomy / friendly / showoff — each weights a pool of idle acts: scuttle along the edge, claw wave, snips, hop, spin, peek, bubble-blowing, and naps with floating z's. Poking it triggers a startle.
- **Shows only when idle:** connected + empty draft (IME-aware) + no attachments, reply target, queue items, active/streaming run, or voice mode. Typing makes it dive behind the composer edge; clearing brings it back.
- **Decorative by contract:** `aria-hidden`, no i18n strings, no config surface. `prefers-reduced-motion` gets a static sprite (no acts on any path, including tab-visibility resumes). Timers pause when the tab is hidden and are cleaned up on disconnect; the act loop avoids lit change-in-update re-renders.

Non-goals: no product/config surface, no behavior change for sending, drafts, slash menus, or run controls.

## User Impact

Web UI users get a small mascot with personality on the empty prompt — different look and behavior each session. Reduced-motion users get a static (still randomized) lobster. No functional change to composing or sending.

## Evidence

Perched on the composer (dark, chonky crimson variant):

![perch closeup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/composer-lobster/2-perch-closeup.png)

Napping with floating z's / waving:

![nap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/composer-lobster/3-nap.png)
![wave](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/composer-lobster/4-wave.png)

Session-seeded variants (palette, accessories, antennae):

![variants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/composer-lobster/5-variants.png)

Full page (dark) and light-mode mobile:

![hero dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/composer-lobster/1-hero-dark.png)
![light mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/composer-lobster/6-light-mobile.png)

Validation (delegated Blacksmith Testbox, `exit=0`):

- `pnpm test ui/src/pages/chat/chat-composer-lobster.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-composer.test.ts` — new suite (seed determinism, variant catalog bounds, act scheduling with fake timers, duck-away on inactive, poke startle, disconnect timer cleanup, reduced-motion inertness incl. visibilitychange resume) plus the existing composer suite.
- `pnpm tsgo:test:ui` typecheck and `pnpm --dir ui build` (vite production build).
- Live verification against `pnpm dev:ui:mock`: perch/duck/return on typing, acts firing over time (wave/scuttle/nap observed), poke startle, per-reload re-randomization, light + mobile rendering, no lit change-in-update warnings in the console (existing `openclaw-terminal-panel` warning is unrelated/pre-existing).
- Codex autoreview: one accepted P2 (reduced-motion bypass on the visibility-resume path) — fixed by guarding `scheduleNextAct()`; regression test added; fresh review clean.
